Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
rrec_count number(8);
rrrec_count number(8);
 begin
nullchk;
select count(*) into rrrec_count from valid_tests
where test_id = :s_test_id;
if rrrec_count = 0 
then 
show_error('1227');
check_package_failure;
else
select count(*) into rrec_count from reagent_store_mst 
where test_id = :s_test_id and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
reagent_status in('R','P','S') and expiry_date >= sysdate and (:global.user_testing_lab_code = '99' or
 lab_code = :global.user_testing_lab_code) and remaining_tests >= 0;
if rrec_count != 0 then
 next_item;
else 
show_error('2317');
end if;
end if;
exception when NO_DATA_FOUND then
show_error('2306');
 
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 begin
 select rsm.reagent_type, rsm.reagent_code, rsm.supplier_code, rsm.lot_number, 
 trunc(rsm.expiry_date), rsm.kit_lot_number, rsm.remaining_tests, rsm.reagent_id, 
 vr.reagent_name 
 into :reagent_type, :reagent_code, :supplier_code, :lot_number, 
 :expiry_date, :kit_lot_number, :remaining_tests, :reagent_id, 
 :reagent_name
 from reagent_store_mst rsm, valid_reagents vr 
 where chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and rsm.reagent_id = :s_reagent_id 
 and rsm.test_id = :s_test_id
 and trunc(rsm.expiry_date) >= sysdate 
 and rsm.reagent_status in ('P', 'R', 'S') 
 and (:global.user_testing_lab_code = '99' or 
 rsm.lab_code = :global.user_testing_lab_code)
 and rsm.visual_qc_flag != 'N' 
 and nvl(rsm.remaining_tests,-1) >= 0
 and rsm.reagent_code = vr.reagent_code
 and vr.test_id = :s_test_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('2309');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
 end;
 if :supplier_code IS NOT NULL then
 begin
 select supplier_name 
 into :supplier_name 
 from suppliers 
 where supplier_code = :supplier_code;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('2309');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error; 
 end;
 end if; 
 go_item('re_chk_in');
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 PRE_INV number(10);
 ADD_INV number(10);
 NEW_INV number(10);
 INITIAL_INV number(10); 
begin
 nullchk;
 PRE_INV := :remaining_tests;
 ADD_INV := :re_chk_in;
 NEW_INV := PRE_INV + ADD_INV;
 if ADD_INV < 0 or ADD_INV = 0 then
 show_error('1813');
 else
 select no_of_tests 
 into INITIAL_INV 
 from reagent_store_mst 
 where reagent_id = :s_reagent_id; 
 if NEW_INV > INITIAL_INV then
 show_error('2401');
 end if;
 end if;
 message('Press [COMMIT] to save.',no_acknowledge);
exception 
 WHEN value_error then
 show_error('2319');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 PRE_INV number(10);
 ADD_INV number(10);
 NEW_INV number(10);
begin
 PRE_INV := :remaining_tests;
 ADD_INV := :re_chk_in;
 NEW_INV := PRE_INV + ADD_INV;
 if :reagent_code IS NOT NULL
 and :reagent_id IS NOT NULL 
 and :re_chk_in IS NOT NULL 
 then
 :chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 :test_id := :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id;
 :remaining_tests := NEW_INV;
 begin 
 update reagent_store_mst 
 set remaining_tests = NEW_INV 
 where reagent_id = :reagent_id;
 :system.message_level := '5';
 commit;bell;
 if form_success then
 show_error('0000');
 clear_block;
 go_item('s_test_id');
 clear_block;
 else
 show_error('2310');
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 else
 show_error('2311');
 end if;
end;
